description: Tells whether one date is a public holiday in Georgia, with its weekday and the holiday name in Georgian or English. The default date is today in Georgia. It supports the years from 2025 to the next year. A one-off day off that the government declares by decree is not in the data: a false answer does not rule one out. Data from Nager.Date.

date.description: The date, YYYY-MM-DD. The default is today in Georgia.

language.description: The language of the holiday name: ka or en. The default is en.

name: holidays_get_day

as_of.description: The instant at which the server read the holidays, RFC 3339.

holiday.description: True when the date is a public holiday.

name.description: The holiday name. Empty when the date is not a public holiday.

source.description: The source of the data: Nager.Date.

stale.description: True when Nager.Date did not answer and the server returns holidays it read before.

weekday.description: The day of the week: monday to sunday.

title: Check a date for a public holiday in Georgia
